items.title: The derived pushforward of the twist of a pulled back quasi-coherent module on the blowup computes the derived tensor product with the ideal power
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file local-cohomology.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement identifies the total derived pushforward along the blowup of the twist of a pulled back quasi-coherent module with the derived tensor product of the module with the corresponding ideal power, for all twists beyond the threshold of the setup (author lemma at source lines 4618-4625, label lemma-compute-tor-Iq); the setup paragraph fixing the blowup and the threshold is reproduced as a context span. The proof (source lines 4627-4640) passes to a free resolution so that the derived pullback is represented explicitly, uses the two defining properties of the threshold to make each term acyclic for global sections and to identify its sections, and then invokes the acyclicity lemma of the chapter on derived categories of schemes to compute the total derived functor termwise (proof lines 4632-4637). The reduction to an explicit complex and the termwise computation are the content. H2.
